scope: Identifier-resolved public herb chemistry and molecular evidence retrieval; no clinical efficacy or whole-herb binding probability

aggregation.transform: clip((pK-4)/5,0,1), engineering monotonic affinity-evidence index, not binding probability; Ki/Kd separate columns
aggregation.herb_aggregation: Maximum supported constituent index per target/endpoint; preserve winner and all supporting records. No concentration, bioavailability, synergy or action-direction inference.
aggregation.set_aggregation: Maximum index across selected herbs per target/endpoint, then mean over requested target/endpoint columns with any supported evidence. Report missing requested columns separately.
aggregation.objective: (1-w)*old evidence objective + w*molecular index - w*0.02*herb_count; w=0.35 default, thus total herb cost remains0.02. Independent disease-research target context, not invented symptom-target edges. Evaluate w=0 ablation, measured_only ablation.
aggregation.missingness: Zero numeric storage always accompanied by observed/predicted masks; absent target columns excluded from molecular denominator; unknown herb-cell means no evidence credit, not weak binding
